name: Attentive Vanes
description: Read the cloth and stance of a target to pick the point where one arrow will hold him.

name: Limbswerve
description: Take a short pace sideways and nock in the same beat to keep the target in line.

name: Vanesthwack
description: Draw a short light arrow and loose it to a mark with a thread of qi.

name: Vanestonic
description: Tilt the shaft against the light to confirm it flies true before it is loosed.

name: Gagging Release
description: Loose an arrow through a sleeve or cloak so the cloth pins the target to a post.

name: Clutching Nock
description: Drive a qi-hardened arrow through the foot or hem and into the ground to stop a charge.

name: Sure Bowstring
description: Call the count of each volley aloud to keep the loosing rhythm even across the line.

name: Nockslap
description: Pulse qi into the draw hand on each cycle so each arrow carries the same push.

name: Vicious Volley
description: Roll the next arrow out of the quiver with a wrist flick as the last one flies.

name: Fleet Serving
description: Turn the shoulder and shift weight forward as each shot leaves to ready the next draw.

name: Drawswat
description: Raise the bow to a high angle and loose a lobbed arrow over a rise.

name: Brisk Limb
description: Loose arrows in a high arc at one patch of ground in a steady stream to hold a body of foes back.

name: Bold Arrowrest
description: Loose three arrows at staggered angles so they fall at different times on one stretch of ground.

name: Patient Bowgrip
description: Press a thumb to the fitting of a narrow-tipped head to feel that it is seated deep.

name: Cometanchor
description: Loose a hard-tipped arrow at an armored foe at near range with a push of qi.

name: Knitting Riser
description: Scan an armored foe for the seam or strap where an arrow will find least resistance.

name: Nockbarrier
description: Hold the bow flat across the forearm and take a glancing blow on the wood.

name: Grim Limbtip
description: Send a bodkin arrow into the gap between plates with qi packed behind the head.

name: Swift Anchor
description: Hold a long draw while qi hardens the narrow head, then loose it through a hide or mail layer.

name: Pirouetting Riser
description: Sink the weight into the saddle and grip with the knees so both hands stay free.

name: Stern Draw
description: Brace the feet in the stirrups and draw the bow while the mount keeps its stride.

name: Quiver Flog
description: Hold the reins in the bow hand and loose a quick arrow at a rider beside the mount.

name: Dire Loose
description: Time the release to the floating beat of the stride when the mount's hooves leave the ground.

name: Vaneshasp
description: Lean low behind the mount's neck to cover from a bolt or arrow.

name: Kindly Nock
description: Slide the quiver to the hip as the mount gathers to feel the arrows settle.

name: Swift Bowgrip
description: Twist in the saddle and loose backward at a pursuer while riding away.

name: Rugged Bowstring
description: Ride a circle around a foe and loose arrows at a steady pace from each point of the ring.

name: Hearty Quiver
description: Pace between known landmarks to count the range to a distant mark by stride.

name: Comet Snapshot
description: Draw to a higher anchor behind the ear to give the arrow a long steady reach.

name: Vanes Linen
description: Watch the dust or splash where the last arrow fell to correct elevation for the next.

name: Gleam Anchor
description: Raise the bow to a steep angle and loose an arrow to a far mark.

name: Lunar Limb
description: Dampen a finger and read the air across the shot to set the aim off the mark.

name: Comet Limbtip
description: Pour qi into the shaft through a long draw and loose it at a mark beyond a hundred paces.

name: Honed Volley
description: Loose a heavy arrow on a high arc with qi packed in the head to bite through a distant shield.

name: Vanescordial
description: Press the sole of the foot into slate or branch to judge if it will hold through a draw.

name: Loose Thwack
description: Aim a hand's width below the mark when shooting steeply down and loose with a push of qi.

name: Release Zip
description: Drop into a low crouch on a perch to hide the outline against the sky.

name: Veering Snapshot
description: Drop from one ledge to the next in a single step while keeping the bow upright.

name: Anchorthwack
description: Loose from a roof edge in a falling line at foes in a narrow street below.

name: Savage Snapshot
description: Lean off a branch to dodge a return shot and loose in the same turn.

name: Attentive Bowgrip
description: Tug the knot of a cord fixed to a shaft to check it will pay out clean.

name: Draught Arrowrest
description: Reel in a paid-out cord while retreating a pace to keep the line taut.

name: Emberanchor
description: Fit a blunt weighted head and loose it at the legs of a charging foe.

name: Emberloose
description: Loose a padded or blunt arrow at the chest or knee to stagger rather than wound.

name: Humvolley
description: Lash a loose cord end across a foe's hand to make him drop what he is holding.

name: Recallriser
description: Fold the net so it opens correctly when loosed from the string.

name: Spliceloose
description: Loose a weighted arrow trailing a cord so it wraps a runner's legs and trips him.

name: Sleet Riser
description: Loose a net-carrying arrow that spreads at mid flight and tangles a fleeing foe.

name: Splice Draw
description: Fit a barbed head and cord, hold the line, and haul a snared foe off his feet.

name: Riserlinen
description: Draw a heavy bow part way many times to wake the back before a full pull.

name: Doughty Bowstring
description: Drive from the hips and back to bring a heavy string to full draw smoothly.

name: Draught Release
description: Set the feet wide and low so the recoil of a heavy release does not rock the frame.

name: Hazelimb
description: Use the thick riser to take a blow on the wood and turn the force aside.

name: Wild Vanes
description: Loose a stout shaft at a flat angle for a hard direct hit.

name: Sleetanchor
description: Hold qi in the back and arms to draw a heavy limb and loose a far hard shaft.

name: Brassquiver
description: Send a thick heavy shaft with the full strength of the draw and a burst of qi at one point.

name: Rallying Serving
description: Slide the grip hand up the riser to shorten the bow for work at close range.

name: Buttressed Nock
description: Hold the bow across the body to take a downward cut on the crossed limbs.

name: Viselike Limbtip
description: Loop the string over a foe's weapon hand and pull to turn the blade off line.

name: Scudding Quiver
description: Step back one pace while raising the bow to open the range for a quick shot.

name: Acrid Draw
description: Spin the bow and strike with the riser at a foe's jaw when he closes.

name: Rushing Serving
description: Drive the stave end into a foe's side after turning his thrust aside.

name: Guarding Limb
description: Circle the bow in front of the body to turn aside a flurry of cuts with qi in the limbs.

name: Twofold Loose
description: Parry a thrust with the stave, step off line and loose a point-blank arrow in one motion.

name: Candor Arrowrest
description: Rub wax into the string and check its give to keep it from stretching in rain.

name: Volleyglide
description: Walk a cord line out into fog to mark the range before the shot.

name: Gap Serving
description: Look for the pale gleam of fletching at dusk to follow the arrow in flight.

name: Shard Anchor
description: Raise the aim to allow for shimmer over hot ground and loose a steady arrow.

name: Sleetnock
description: Wrap the draw hand to keep the string from slipping and hold a wet-weather draw.

name: Staticanchor
description: Loose a spinning arrow through fog with qi at the fletching to hold a straight line.

name: Fierce Limbtip
description: Hold a drawn arrow in a downpour while qi dries and hardens the head, then loose it.

name: Brisk Volley
description: Loose a stream of faintly lit arrows at dusk to herd or pin foes the light hides.
